source.author: Shao-Jiang Wang
source.title: 100 Sharply Formulated Open Problems in Theoretical Physics
source.assessment: Named-author, explicitly AI-assisted discovery catalogue. Scope and overlap checked; this is not a comprehensive current-literature or proof audit. New text is editorially reformulated; no reuse license for the source article is asserted.
